title: Conventional 2x2 crossover, sample size at 80% power

source.method_note: PowerTOST default is the EXACT method (Owen's Q); be-stats uses the non-central t approximation. Sample size must agree exactly; power is compared within tolerance.

notes: n is the decisive assertion. The power tolerance was set from the measured difference between the two methods (1.9e-07), not chosen in advance.
